add.q: Consider these statements about timekeeping in ancient India. (I) The earliest reference to shadow-based time measurement in India appears in the Arthasastra by Kautilya, and Varahamihira later gave an accurate expression for time using a stick's shadow around 530 CE. (II) The Ghatika-yantra measured time by the steady melting of a candle marked with equal intervals. (III) Each time the bowl of the Ghatika-yantra sank, the event was announced using drums, conch shells, or by striking a gong. Which is or are correct?
o: Only I and III
Only I
Only II and III
All of these
